subject: health
unitTitle: Nutrition, Movement, Sleep, and Body Respect
title: Launch and diagnostic: adequate and varied fueling
essentialQuestion: How can understanding nutrition, movement, sleep, and body respect help us explain, decide, create, or solve something that matters?
materials: unit-specific source, model, manipulatives, safe materials, or approved digital tool
keyPoints: Growing bodies need adequate food across the day and a range of foods that supply energy and nutrients; restriction and appearance-based rules can interfere with wellbeing.
Compare care options by function, access, safety, and sustainability; avoid appearance rules, shame, rigid perfection, or assumptions about another person’s habits.
For adequate and varied fueling, a strong response distinguishes fact from assumption, uses a fictional or public case, and includes a safe next step or appropriate source of support.
privacySafeScenario: Design several flexible wellness routines without calorie targets, dieting, weight cutting, weigh-ins, or body comparison.
studentTask: Use the supplied fictional day to create a care plan for adequate and varied fueling. Identify two needs or barriers, choose two feasible supports, and explain how each supports function or recovery without appearance rules, shame, or a requirement to reveal personal habits.
knowledgeCheck: In two or three sentences, explain the most important distinction in adequate and varied fueling; use one lesson fact and name the evidence, safety check, or support route that makes the explanation dependable.
completionCriteria: The response completes every named part of the adequate and varied fueling task using the supplied fictional or public case.
